title: Carry-forward r1#19: demo UI still shows real-person name 'Grace Kelly' for the rejected/eviction applicant; only the PDF side was renamed 'Gráinne Foley'
evidence: demo_fixtures.gleam:93: const app_grace_json = "{\"id\":\"a-grace\",\"vacancy_id\":\"v-maples\",\"first_name\":\"Grace\",\"last_name\":\"Kelly\",\"email\":\"grainne.foley@example.ie\" ... \"has_eviction_history\":true,\"eviction_details\":\"Rent arrears, possession order settled in 2024\",\"has_ccjs\":true ... \"status\":\"rejected\"" — demo_store.gleam:1435: #("a-grace", "RightTenantry-Report-Grace-Kelly.pdf") — while server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam row_grace() builds base_row("a-grace", "Gráinne", "Foley", "grainne.foley@example.ie", ...)
detail: The r1 fix renamed only the baked PDF payload and email; the client fixture that renders the leaderboard, applicant detail and comparison still attaches a famous real person's name to fabricated eviction/CCJ data on the ungated public demo — and the UI name now contradicts the downloaded PDF for the same applicant id.
recommended_fix: Rename the client fixture to 'Gráinne Foley' (demo_fixtures.gleam app_grace_json and demo_store.gleam report_filenames entry) and re-run the conformance test.

title: lint_demo_network.py guard check is window-based — an unguarded arm within 35 lines below a guarded arm passes the lint
evidence:
# Check a generous window above the call for a demo_mode guard in the
        # same scope (the False branch of a demo case can sit 10+ lines below
        # the guard when the True branch is verbose).
        window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
        if not guarded:
detail: Verified by test: a synthetic client.gleam with a guarded UserClickedGuardedThing arm followed by an unguarded UserClickedNewUnguardedThing arm calling application_api.fetch_leaderboard exits 0 ('demo no-network lint clean'). A future arm added near a guarded arm inherits its guard; a call in a True branch also passes.
recommended_fix: Parse brace/indent scope instead of a line window: verify the api call is inside the False branch of the nearest demo_mode case, or track guarded scopes with a small Gleam-arm parser.

title: Carry-forward r1#24: demo comparison selections and sweep-nudge dismissals still write real browser storage and hydrate back into real sessions
detail: No demo branch on these arms: demo ids ('a-aoife') persist in the real user's storage keys and are hydrated unconditionally at the next real boot, leaking demo selections into a live session's comparison view.
recommended_fix: Skip save_comparison_ids/save_dismissed_sweep_nudges when model.demo_mode, or key demo selections under a demo-scoped storage key.

title: Policy re-acceptance modal can surface in demo after a future policy-version bump — 'Accept' fires a real auth_api.accept_policy POST from a demo branch
evidence:
UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy( — enter_demo sets: Model(..model, route:, auth: Success(landlord), csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token", demo_mode: True, demo_store: Some(store), ...) with no server_policy_version reset — model.gleam:744: Success(landlord) if model.server_policy_version != "" -> ... order.Lt -> True
detail: enter_demo keeps the real session's server_policy_version while swapping in a fixture landlord pinned to '2026-05-23'. Any future policy bump makes order.Lt true, rendering the modal in demo; UserAcceptedPolicy then POSTs with the demo CSRF token plus any live session cookie.
recommended_fix: Reset server_policy_version to "" in enter_demo (policy_reaccept_required then always returns False in demo), or intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.
